title: Replication package for: Many small carriers: the mean-field limit of competitive urban delivery under zone-time charges
description:
Code, instances, result files and Lean 4 sources that reproduce the numbers, tables and figures of the manuscript 'Many small carriers: the mean-field limit of competitive urban delivery under zone-time charges'. The package contains the Python package mfgcc and its tests, the resumable experiment drivers and analysis scripts, all result CSV files for nine cities (Berlin, Buenos Aires, Cairo, London, Mumbai, Moscow, New Delhi, New York, Paris), the LaTeX sources of the paper with the generated number macros and tables, brute-force checks of the theory, the calibration parameter tables with sources and quality grades, and derived zone tables, road graphs and travel-time matrices for the nine cities.

Licences: code MIT; results, figures, parameter tables and paper sources CC BY 4.0; the derived city data in data/processed contain information from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0) and GHSL GHS-POP R2023A (CC BY 4.0) and remain under those terms (see NOTICE). Raw OpenStreetMap extracts and point-of-interest lists are not included. See README.md for how to run the tests and regenerate the key tables.
